Dear Routakallion Infra,

Thanks for letting us know you're finished with the 10m scissor lift. We're happy to arrange collection from your site, or you're welcome to drop it back at the depot - let us know which you'd prefer.

On the other two items: we're still working on availability for the pressure washer dates and will have options for you shortly, and we're still reviewing the diamond floor saw invoice - if you can send the invoice number, that'll help speed that one up.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service
